findings.detail: 'res' takes add_all_subclasses's int status and is never tested. Unlike a NULL pointer returned straight back to the caller, a `return res` at the end of the function stops nothing in between: the code below runs with a live exception, and anything it commits or skips (a rollback, a slot update) happens anyway. Test res at the assignment and take the error path there.
PyErr_Clear() with no PyErr_ExceptionMatches within the preceding 3 lines — swallows any live exception, including KeyboardInterrupt and MemoryError raised by user code
